controls: Check exact coefficient factorization and the delta derivative identities.
Prove the fixed real-Q half-line is progressive from a strict principal-branch real-part lower bound uniform on the open parameter disk.
Check the exact Liouville-Green transform and residual identity.
Check the exact residual rational form and closed-form L1 kernel majorant.
Require the rational Volterra operator norm bound V_bar to be strictly below 1 and 1/10000.
At 128 and 256 bits, outwardly enclose the fixed-box Q=4 branch, WKB pair, V_bar and q_bar; tier overlap is consistency only.
Apply the self-contained Banach-Volterra proof only after every analytic hypothesis passes, fixing uniqueness in the bounded-H normalized recessive class.
